title: Floor 5 Hostile Takeover castle siege
description: Implement Floor 5 as a deterministic MOBA-shaped castle siege: opposing autonomous waves, boss-strength enemy Heroes, field-task-gated siege construction, Command Post defense, a protected Ratings Ram breach, and a courtyard-to-throne capture finale.

review.body: Source of truth: .specify/specs/floor5-hostile-takeover.md, docs/knowledge/game-design/floor5-hostile-takeover.md, and ADR 0094. HUMAN_GATE before approval (design decisions only, all answerable from the documents today): confirm terminal rules and their precedence, the ram recovery model, and the throne capture-interaction model. Numeric balance decisions — duration and completion-rate targets, Hero slot count and respawn cadence, and entity/frame performance budgets — are explicitly DEFERRED to slice-8-balance-verification, because the spec and content bible require them to be chosen from representative runtime evidence that only exists once the implementation slices have run; approving this review means accepting that deferral plan, not supplying those numbers. Close this exact revision as completed only when the implementation graph, the design decisions above, and the deferral plan are acceptable.

nodes.title: Floor 5 Slice 1: siege architecture, floor plumbing, authored map, and phase skeleton
nodes.body: Implement the Floor 5 manifest/registry/scenario foundation, authored Command Post-to-throne map, siege phase state, siegeDirectorSystem authority boundary, isolated RNG stream keys, and a minimal scenario-AI route. Add the required lab and real ScenarioDefinition wiring. Done when the windowed game and headless runner load the same reachable map and emit the same empty deterministic phase trace.

nodes.title: Floor 5 Slice 2: teams, minion waves, structures, and Command Post defense
nodes.body: Implement explicit team/structure contracts, siegeMinionSystem strategic targeting, opposing immutable wave manifests, bounded per-team spawn debt, checkpoint fronts, and immediate Command Post defeat precedence. Reuse shared navigation, attacks, and damage. Done when a real headless run completes an opposing-wave cycle, contests a checkpoint, damages only legal targets, and records no path stalls.

nodes.title: Floor 5 Slice 3: field tasks, requisition milestones, and siege construction
nodes.body: Implement the Siege Yard, opening-push and component/checkpoint task contracts, floor-scoped requisition milestones, quest-event projection, and interruptible Ratings Ram construction prerequisites. Done when headless completes every task, cannot build early, and deterministically pauses/resumes construction under attack without consuming persistent inventory or gold.

nodes.title: Floor 5 Slice 4: enemy Hero roster, strategic AI, and respawn contracts
nodes.body: Author the append-only field-Hero roster and implement seeded without-replacement slots, siegeHeroSystem role-scoped targeting, task/build-aware target priorities, abilities, telegraphs, defeat handling, and fixed-tick respawns. Done when headless reproduces the same Hero card, observes behavior consistent with each Hero's single declared role, defeats a Hero, and verifies its manifest-authored respawn or permanent defeat.

nodes.title: Floor 5 Slice 5: Ratings Ram escort, recovery, and atomic wall breach
nodes.body: Implement the full Ratings Ram state machine, authored route, protection condition, destruction/rebuild path, wall attacks, persistent breach latch, and atomic collision/navigation/front-line transition. Apply explicit cleanup/retreat rules to Heroes, minions, route markers, and spawn debt. Done when headless builds, destroys and rebuilds, escorts, and breaches without a soft lock or render/navigation mismatch.

nodes.title: Floor 5 Slice 6: courtyard, Crown Auditor, Regent, and throne capture
nodes.body: Implement the breach-to-courtyard handoff, fixed Crown Auditor encounter, throne-door gate, Regent Emeritus boss, bounded summons, separate capture interaction, terminal cleanup, and Winner's Balcony exit. Done when a real headless run crosses the latched breach, clears both encounters, cannot capture early, captures exactly once, and produces one terminal outcome.

nodes.title: Floor 5 Slice 7: narrative, quests, HUD, audio, sprites, and visual proof
nodes.body: Ship the Hostile Takeover quest pack and authored Director lines, phase/objective/Base/Ram/checkpoint/Hero/capture HUD, accessible team markers, deterministic audio/VFX cues, castle/engine/Hero assets, and set-piece dressing. Done when deterministic real-game captures prove lane allegiance, base alarm, task/build state, Hero salience, engine damage, persistent breach, throne escalation, and victory without color-only meaning.

nodes.title: Floor 5 Slice 8: integrated QA, performance, balance, and achievements
nodes.body: Add integrated/property/E2E/headless gates, achievements, and telemetry for outcomes, phase durations, base health, ram lifecycle, breach, Heroes, path stalls, allegiance, and terminal integrity. Obtain every deferred numeric HUMAN_GATE approval here, now that representative runtime evidence exists: requisition component/checkpoint counts (HUMAN_GATE-1), ram HP, protection thresholds, advance speed and rebuild delay/cost (HUMAN_GATE-2), Hero slot count and respawn cadence (HUMAN_GATE-3), Regent summon cap and telegraph timing (HUMAN_GATE-6), stall-backstop duration (HUMAN_GATE-7), achievement thresholds (HUMAN_GATE-8), and completion-rate, duration, base-health cushion, ram survival and entity/frame budgets (spec FR10.4); then tune against representative GitHub-backed sweeps. Done when approved thresholds pass with zero unreachable objectives, phase violations, invalid targets, navigation mismatches, unbounded debt, or non-terminal runs.
